correctness.rationale: Each branch derivative is an explicit signed monomial matrix, and exact multiplication yields the singular powers of two from suffix-visit counts. The normalized Lebesgue coding has independent fair branch symbols. Reversed finite words realize a half-lazy directed cyclic walk. For every centered test function \(g\), solve \(h(j)-h(j+1)=2g(j)\); the bounded martingale differences are \(\pm g(W_t)\), with conditional variance \(g(W_t)^2\). Finite-state ergodicity and the bounded martingale CLT imply covariance \(\frac1m I_m-\frac1{m^2}\mathbf1\mathbf1^\top\); sorting and second-moment uniform integrability prove the extrema and mean correction. For fixed \(m\), cyclic rotation of prefix counts proves almost-sure equal Lyapunov rates. Exact two-dimensional binomial counting and all-word integer-matrix enumeration corroborate, but do not replace the infinite proof.
